text:
Alex: Heads up — nightly eval for candidate redwood-x-3b-qat-2026-03 popped multiple failing suites, looks like a multi-cohort flip. :rotating_light:
eval-bot: nightly-eval | model=redwood-x-3b-qat-2026-03 | failures=4 | top_failures=[longcontext-coherence, finance-fewshot, instruct-correctness, cli-qa] | delta_accuracy=-8.3% | hallucination_rate+12.0% | empty_output_rate=3.2%
Mira: Ugh. Which cohorts flipped direction (good->bad or bad->good)?
Alex: Mixed — finance-fewshot actually improved slightly but longcontext and instruct got worse. cli-qa produced truncated/empty generations on ~3% of prompts.
Sam: Is this the quantization variant we rolled in yesterday (`qconfig=v7-altcache`)?
Alex: Yep, this is the altcache quant path from the onboarding experiment. Hypothesis: KV-cache handling with the new kernel + quant path is dropping prefixes for long sequences.
Jen: Can you paste the eval command and a short log excerpt?
Alex: Reproducer run command: `./eval/run.py --model=redwood-x-3b-qat-2026-03 --cohort=longcontext-coherence --seed=42 --limit=200`
Alex: Log snippet: ```kvcache: init cache size=2048
kvcache: step=0 restore: found empty kv segment for layer=10
runtime: peeled tokens=512 but kvcache len=0 -> fallback to fresh state
```
Kai: That log lines up with the empty_output spikes. If KV isn't restored, prefix is lost -> short/truncated answers and hallucinations.
Mira: Initial severity=high for longcontext (customer impact on long docs) and medium for instruct/cli. Recommend P1->P2 escalation? Thoughts? :eyes:
Sam: Agree set longcontext to P1 until we have a hotfix or rollback. Others P2. I'll take oncall for immediate mitigation.
Jen: Mitigation options: (1) rollback to qconfig=v6 (previous quant) for onboarding candidate; (2) pin model to previous stable variant in serving pool; (3) disable altcache quant kernel in runtime via flag `--disable-altcache` and run smoke suite.
Mira: Prefer rollback + smoke. Rolling back the quant sounds safest. Who can trigger?
Sam: I'll run rollback for the staging lane and kick a smoke eval. Command I'll run: `infra/deploy/rollout --model redwood-x-3b-qat-2026-03 --variant qconfig=v6 --lane=staging --reason="eval regression"`
Alex: After rollback, please run the same reproducer on longcontext + cli-qa and post deltas. If rollback fixes, we'll hold the candidate from production.
Mira: Owner assignment: Mira (primary) for triage and repro, Sam (oncall) for rollback/rollback verification, Jen (runtime) to audit kernel/kv restore code, Kai (eval) to re-run nightly with extra logging.
Sam: On it. I'll post results in ~15-20m. :thumbsup:
eval-bot: job queued | job=smoke-longcontext-staging | triggered_by=Sam | eta=12m
Alex: Thanks — if anyone sees related alert spikes in prod, ping ops and escalate. We should create a short incident if rollback doesn't fix.
Mira: Noted. Adding a checklist: 1) reproduce locally (Mira) 2) rollback staging (Sam) 3) extra KV logging + kernel flags (Jen) 4) rerun full nightly for candidate (Kai) 5) hold candidate if fix confirmed (Alex)
Jen: Also will open a quick PR to add a kvcache runtime assertion to fail early when restore len mismatches. Small safety net.
Kai: Will add the cohort-level diffs to the eval dashboard and link here once done.
Sam: Rolling now. Posting status after smoke run.
Alex: Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
